name: mutual
grammar: grammar LeftRec { @package: leftrecprobe  @root @mapping(Node) Root ::= A; A ::= B; B ::= Root | 'x'; }

name: nullable-helper
grammar: grammar LeftRec { @package: leftrecprobe  @root @mapping(Node) Root ::= N Root | 'x'; N ::= [ 'n' ]; }

name: nullable-chain
grammar: grammar LeftRec { @package: leftrecprobe  @root @mapping(Node) Root ::= A Root | 'x'; A ::= B; B ::= [ 'n' ]; }

name: empty-token
grammar: grammar LeftRec { @package: leftrecprobe token E = EMPTY @root @mapping(Node) Root ::= E Root | 'x'; }

name: eof-token
grammar: grammar LeftRec { @package: leftrecprobe token E = EOF @root @mapping(Node) Root ::= E Root | 'x'; }

name: lookahead-token
grammar: grammar LeftRec { @package: leftrecprobe token P = LOOKAHEAD('x') @root @mapping(Node) Root ::= P Root | 'x'; }

name: until-token
grammar: grammar LeftRec { @package: leftrecprobe token P = UNTIL('x') @root @mapping(Node) Root ::= P Root | 'x'; }

name: error-guard
grammar: grammar LeftRec { @package: leftrecprobe  @root @mapping(Node) Root ::= ERROR('no') Root | 'x'; }

name: consuming-token
grammar: grammar LeftRec { @package: leftrecprobe token D = DigitParser @root @mapping(Node) Root ::= D [ Root ] | 'x'; }

name: zero-maximum-mutual
grammar: grammar LeftRec { @package: leftrecprobe @root @mapping(Node) Root ::= Alias{0} 'x'; Alias ::= Root '!'; }

name: zero-maximum-live-successor
grammar: grammar LeftRec { @package: leftrecprobe @root @mapping(Node) Root ::= Root{0} Root | 'x'; }

name: owned-capture-cycle
grammar: grammar LeftRec { @package: leftrecprobe @root @mapping(Node) Root ::= CAPTURE(word, Root); }

name: owned-replay-nullable-prefix
grammar: grammar LeftRec { @package: leftrecprobe @root @mapping(Node) Root ::= SAME_AS(word) Root | 'x'; }
